_comment: Pterodactyl / Pelican egg for the Minestom lobby. Import it in the admin panel: Nests > Import Egg.
name: Minestom Lobby
author: mohammadhadimohammadi2007-dot@users.noreply.github.com
description: A lobby server for Minecraft networks, built on Minestom. Runs on its own (standalone) or behind Velocity. Clients from 1.8.9 to the latest through ViaVersion on the proxy. https://github.com/mohammadhadimohammadi2007-dot/lobby

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Downloads lobby-server.jar. Leave DOWNLOAD_URL empty to upload the jar yourself in the file manager.
cd /mnt/server
if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ]; then
    echo "Downloading ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
    curl -fsSL -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" || { echo "Download failed"; exit 1; }
else
    echo "No DOWNLOAD_URL: upload ${SERVER_JARFILE} with the file manager before starting."
fi
mkdir -p worlds
echo "Done. Copy your world folder to worlds/lobby (it is converted to Polar on the first start)."

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The lobby jar file in the server folder.

variables.name: Download URL
variables.description: Where the installer downloads lobby-server.jar from. The default is always the newest release; a URL with /releases/download/v0.2.0/ instead of /releases/latest/download/ keeps one version. Empty: upload the jar yourself.
